reasoning: EvalHub is a lightweight REST API service for orchestrating LLM evaluations across multiple backends (lm-evaluation-harness, RAGAS, Garak, GuideLLM). It builds into a Go server binary (eval-hub) that listens on port 8080, exposes HTTP endpoints for creating and listing evaluations, serves OpenAPI docs, provides Prometheus metrics at /metrics, and includes health/status endpoints. It uses net/http routing, structured logging with zap, PostgreSQL/SQLite storage, and OpenTelemetry tracing. It is deployed as a container on OpenShift, managed by the TrustyAI Service Operator via a custom resource. The project also includes companion binaries (eval-runtime-init for S3 data download, eval-runtime-sidecar for Kubernetes job pod proxying), but the primary artifact is the API service.
